comportamentos: PDF generation registers DejaVu and Noto Sans Math font families and adds them to the fallback fonts, so unicode or math characters such as sigma in thesis titles render: missing

Database support for unicode in thesis_title: the official fix makes no DB change, but the candidate adds a utf8mb4 migration and database.yml settings (different approach, not mirrored in the official fix)
justificativa: The candidate only changes the MySQL charset of thesis_title, while the official fix adds unicode and math fallback fonts to PDF generation so characters like sigma render; that PDF behavior is entirely absent.
